technical.summary: ACN shows isolated oversold bounce signals (Williams %R, StochRSI cross) but lacks confluence; pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative MACD, weak momentum) and absent volume support make this a low-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 36 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (2 sales vs 1 small purchase) and disabled news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (417.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 36 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (10/100) + Williams %R oversold + StochRSI bullish cross create contrarian bounce setup near support (270.56), with 6-point resistance range offering defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative MACD, weak RSI, no volume confirmation) combined with crisis-level VIX, unfavorable macro, earnings risk in 36 days, and zero institutional/insider conviction make this a low-probability entry with severe headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear sentiment and Williams %R oversold conditions present a contrarian bounce setup, the pervasive bearish technical structure (price below all MAs, negative MACD, no volume confirmation) combined with crisis-level macro conditions (VIX 417.4) and upcoming earnings in 36 days create unacceptable risk-reward.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX and unfavorable macro environment (flat yield curve, rising DXY) could trigger further downside acceleration before any bounce materializes, with earnings execution risk amplifying volatility in 36 days.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite isolated oversold signals
decision.portfolio_note: No sector concentration concern (0 IT positions), but 32 open positions and 0% drawdown suggest portfolio is already fully deployed; adding low-conviction trade inappropriate.
